event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Singapore Straits Singapore 01° 03.40' N 103° 38.40' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2024
sources.text: Alert crew onboard the ship underway noticed two unauthorised persons onboard. Alarm raised and the crew mustered, resulting the persons escaping empty handed. The incident reported to Singapore VTS.
